title: Documents
description: Create, read and edit Word documents (.docx): reports, letters and contracts with real styles, tables, headers and page numbers, find-and-replace that keeps formatting, and conversion to PDF.
prompts: Write a two-page project proposal as proposal.docx with a title, headings, a budget table and page numbers
Replace the client name and date in contract.docx without changing its formatting
Summarize report.docx and list every table it contains
